Case note: S.C.C. No. 995/2024
Client: Joseph Bose (cardiologist, Pune)
Opposing party: M/s Emerald Enterprises
Court: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Pune
Filed on: 19 December 2024
Claim amount: Rs 24,40,000
Issue: cheque bounce. The drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction.
Advice given: Argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted.
Outcome: The drawer's application to discharge the complaint was rejected.
Recommended next step: Press for an early date for cross-examination.
